debit.notes: Bank is in liquidation — no blocking channel is published anywhere on its live official site. RBI cancelled PPBL's banking licence under Section 22(4) BR Act effective close of business 24 Apr 2026 (Press Release 2026-2027/143), and the Delhi High Court ordered its winding up on 8 Jul 2026 (Official Liquidator: Girikumar M. Nair). The only live official page (www.paytm.bank.in — paytmbank.com redirects there; every other path returns CloudFront 403 and all footer links such as Contact Us / Report a Fraud / Debit & ATM Card are dead javascript:void(0)) publishes no phone number, no SMS short code, no netbanking and no block/hotlist instruction; it states 'The PPBL mobile application is currently not available for use'. Write to ol@paytmbank.com or nodalofficer@paytmbank.com 'about your concerns'; depositor claims are deemed filed in the winding up and customers must wait for the official claim-process communication on paytm.bank.in. The old 0120-3888-388, 1800-1800-1091 and support@paytmbank.com no longer appear on any official page and were dropped. Payments bank: its own FAQ says it 'cannot issue loans or credit cards', so no credit section. The bank's pages do not mention 1930.
